name: User-defined routes (UDR)
short_description: Custom routes in an Azure route table, associated with a subnet, that override Azure's default system routes, for example to send outbound traffic through a firewall or virtual appliance as the next hop.

evidence.quote: That's when you need user-defined routes or UDRs.
